title: Hospital Operations Executive
summary: Hospital operations executives keep patients moving smoothly through an Indian hospital, from OPD registration and admission to bed allotment and discharge. They report to the operations manager and coordinate daily with nursing, billing, doctors and support teams.
dailyDuties: Coordinate inpatient admissions and discharges with ward teams
Prepare the bed status report and allot beds
Supervise OPD registration and doctor appointments
Check entries in the hospital information system
Resolve patient and attendant complaints on the floor
Maintain records needed for NABH audits
Send the daily MIS on admissions, discharges and occupancy

skills.expectation: Coordinate inpatient admissions and discharges and keep discharge time low
Track bed status and allot beds to emergency and planned admissions
Run OPD registration, appointments and front desk flow
Record registrations, admissions and transfers in the hospital information system
Keep records and processes in line with NABH standards and audits
Prepare daily MIS on admissions, discharges and occupancy
Resolve patient and attendant complaints on the floor
Coordinate nursing, billing, pharmacy and housekeeping teams
Explain processes clearly to patients, families and doctors
Check IPD and OPD bills and estimates before discharge
Coordinate with the insurance desk on cashless approvals
Handle escalations from patients and VIP cases
Understand common medical terms used on wards
Maintain occupancy and turnaround trackers in spreadsheets
